text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to lock in a gain; my average cost is not a reason to trade, and I should weigh risk and expected return instead.","A loss feels painful, but I should not hold a position merely to avoid admitting a mistake; I should review it by the same standards as any other holding.","Monthly price moves are random and past changes do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term noise and keep a diversified portfolio."]}
